JoinUs.heroDescription: Riwaya blog is looking for a talented and creative blogger for an official position on the blog. If you are talented, love blogging, and have many ideas, we are looking for you. Write a sample post + an introduction about yourself and send everything to Riwaya team.
JoinUs.conditionsDescription: Thank you for choosing to contribute your topics to Riwaya blog. We invite you to read these conditions so your topic can be published:
JoinUs.condition1Title: We do not accept fully copied topics
JoinUs.condition1Desc: Riwaya blog's policy over the past 31 years has been based on enriching Arabic technical content, therefore we do not accept topics copied entirely from other sites. On the other hand, we accept topics written in your own words even if they come from one or multiple sources.
JoinUs.condition2Title: We do not accept previously covered topics
JoinUs.condition2Desc: Of course, we cannot publish topics that have already been published in order to avoid repetition.
JoinUs.condition3Title: We do not accept topics containing activation codes or software
JoinUs.condition3Desc: At Riwaya blog, we ensure not to violate intellectual property rights. However, we accept topics containing official activation codes obtained through legal means.
JoinUs.condition4Title: We do not accept poorly written topics
JoinUs.condition4Desc: We all make mistakes, and a few minor errors are fine, but if they make sentences incomprehensible or if there are too many spelling mistakes, it is impossible to publish.
JoinUs.applyDescription: In order to send us your post, please write it in a Word file and send it to the blog via WhatsApp.

ReturnPolicyPage.Section1Desc: In accordance with current legislation, you have a period of <bold>3 calendar days</bold> from the receipt of your order to request an exchange or a return if the product does not suit you.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section2Desc: To be eligible for a return, your book must be in the same condition as when you received it (unread, without marks, creases, or annotations). The original packaging must be kept.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section3Desc: If you receive a damaged book or one with a manufacturing defect, we commit to replacing it free of charge as soon as possible.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section4Desc: To initiate a return, please contact our customer service via WhatsApp or by email at admin@riwaya.store. Please include your order number and photos if the product is defective.

ShippingPolicyPage.Title: Shipping Policy
ShippingPolicyPage.Section1Desc: <bold>Riwaya</bold> delivers to all cities in the Kingdom of Morocco. Whether you are in Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, or more remote areas, we ensure that your books arrive safely.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section2Desc: Our delivery times generally vary between <bold>24h and 48h</bold> working days for major cities. For other regions, the delay can extend up to 4 working days.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section3Desc: Delivery costs are 25 MAD for Casablanca and 35 MAD for other cities. Delivery is free for any order over 300 MAD.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section4Desc: Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a confirmation by SMS or WhatsApp with the necessary information to track the status of your delivery.

PrivacyPage.Title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.Section1Desc: We collect the necessary data to process your orders (name, shipping address, phone number) as well as the information shared via our contact form, our newsletter, or WhatsApp. We also collect anonymized browsing data.
PrivacyPage.Section2Desc: Your information is used for shipping your orders, customer support, and improving our store. We also use this data, with your consent, to personalize your experience and offer you relevant advertisements.
PrivacyPage.Section3Desc: Riwaya uses cookies, <bold>Google Analytics 4</bold>, and <bold>Google Tag Manager (GTM)</bold> to understand the use of our site, measure our audience, and continuously improve our services.
PrivacyPage.Section4Desc: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting <link>Google Ads Settings</link>.
PrivacyPage.Section5Desc: Data related to your orders is kept for the legal duration necessary for accounting and management purposes. Browsing data and cookies are kept according to current recommendations.
PrivacyPage.Section6Desc: In accordance with data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at <contact>admin@riwaya.store</contact>.

CookieBanner.Message: We use cookies to improve your experience on our site and personalize ads. By continuing to browse, you agree to our use of cookies.

TermsPage.Title: Terms and Conditions
TermsPage.Section1Desc: These Terms and Conditions govern all transactions made on the <bold>Riwaya</bold> website. By using our platform or placing an order, you agree to these terms in full.
TermsPage.Section2Desc: All orders are subject to stock availability. We offer Cash on Delivery (COD). Payment is required at the time the order is handed over to the customer by our delivery service.
TermsPage.Section3Desc: We deliver everywhere in Morocco. Delivery times vary depending on your city and product availability. Riwaya strives to meet the announced deadlines but is not responsible for delays caused by shipping companies.
TermsPage.Section4Desc: If a received item is defective or non-compliant, you have a period defined in our return policy to contact us. Books must be returned in their original condition.
TermsPage.Section5Desc: All content on the riwaya.store website (texts, images, logos) is protected by copyright. Any unauthorized reproduction is strictly prohibited.
TermsPage.Section6Desc: Riwaya reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the site. We encourage you to review this page regularly.
